fit: One proposal from unchanged anchor only; corrected ENTSO-E SDAC 2025 prices. No adaptive refit.
features: 15 seasonal/local-clock columns plus centered local weekend; no residual demand or observed hourly generation
resource_fit: Only positive, interior offers with cost equal to local anchor price within 1e-5 EUR/MWh; unsupported resource-zone fits stay zero
offers: Add bounded correction to inherited daily fuel/carbon/VOM and existing bid strategy, floor at zero. Same shift for all tranches within a zone/resource, preserving order. Oil/CHP, renewable bids, emergency and fixed hydro unchanged.
budget: Exactly three new 8760-hour clears and one byte-identical reused control; no implicit resume or search expansion
selection: Lowest all-year equal-zone MAE among cases with zero emergency, native/KKT certification, fitted-country solar monthly MAE <= 1.05 times control and thermal monthly normalized allocation-interval error <= 1.05 times control. Ties prefer control then earlier declared case.
generation_guard: 5% tolerance is an experimental selection rule, not a product acceptance gate; all generation results and rejected cases retained
scope: Retrospective all-2025 calibration and evaluation, not independent forecast validation or uniquely inferred bids. No public model replacement, storage/investment acceptance or review restart.
